summary: RETEST of the 2 backend bugs raised in iteration_15. Both fixes verified: (1) POST /api/properties/{pid}/events now exists and returns 200 with event_id; the created event is picked up by GET /budget (total_cents=15000, 'Karim B.' present in top_artisans). (2) Equipment creation with warranty_until='2027-01-15' (date-only ISO) now returns _auto_reminders_created=2 and GET /reminders lists BOTH 'entretien' and 'garantie' auto_generated reminders. Full pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_home_os_passport.py now passes 10/10 (was 7/10). Also ran an explicit end-to-end scenario mirroring the review-request payload to double-confirm.
action_items: Nothing blocking — both critical bugs from iteration_15 are resolved. Optional cleanup carried over: split server.py (still 4700+ lines) and remove the duplicate budget-aggregation code path between server.py and services/homes.py; also consider removing the blanket `except Exception: pass` in generate_reminders_for_equipment so future date-parsing regressions surface immediately.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixes for tz-naive vs tz-aware datetime comparison and for POST /events are effective end-to-end. Consider logging (WARN) inside the reminder-generation exception handler to catch future silent failures.
server.py file size (>4700 lines) still exceeds the 700-line guideline — recommend extracting a home_os router module in a follow-up refactor.

Next iteration should focus on the frontend integration of these endpoints (Property list with cover_color, equipment auto-reminders visible in UI, budget screen showing top_artisans, share/passport public preview).
